releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.26 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Tier 1 & 2: 64-bit dHash (Difference Hashing) with Hamming distance similarity matching (<=10 bits)
* Solves 0 Hits bug: Learned and pinned ads reliably match despite video playback, timers, or compression
* Tier 2: Static Header & Footer Chrome hashing isolates ad controls from center video movement
* Tier 3: High-contrast circular close badge scanner detects ✕ and skip glyphs across corners & card dialogs (Y ~ 350-400)
* Instant vision trigger on ad entry (zero-wait on screen transition)
* Preloads persistent dHash fingerprints from cached screenshots on service start
